Chapter 52: Chapter 49: Top Ten Changes

Chapter 52: Chapter 49: Top Ten Changes

Cang Lan Star Virtual World.

Early morning, Central Plaza Area.

A towering Canglan Evolution Ranking stood erect while a middle-aged man with reddened eyes casually sat on a chair, his gaze occasionally flicking towards the evolution ranking.

His name was Pei Lu, a member of the Pei Family from Canglan Star.

The Pei Family was a well-known family of evolvers on Canglan Star.

There were two types of evolvers: unique-type evolvers and general-type evolvers.

Among the unique-type evolvers, there were many categories, one of which included lineage evolvers.

...

Lineage evolvers, the foundation of many evolver families, had their evolutionary abilities passed down through their bloodlines.

Compared to other evolvers, the cultivation for lineage evolvers was much easier, merely needing to continuously unlock the potential of their bloodlines.

Of course, the drawback was also clear—the limit of their bloodline was their own limit. Prior to reaching the limit of their bloodline, they wouldn’t encounter any setbacks or obstacles, but once they reached that limit, it was basically impossible to break through.

The Pei Family was a Third Rank lineage evolver family.

“I wonder why the family head is so concerned about the evolution ranking…”

Pei Lu was somewhat bored. In ten minutes, the evolution ranking was due for an update. Ever since, half a year ago, a path called the Martial Path Evolutionary Path broke into the top hundred of the ranking.

The family head then ordered him to watch over it at this time every day and to immediately report any changes back to the family.

Actually, not just the Pei Family, but other powers on Canglan Star had basically started sending people to guard the evolution ranking.

The Canglan Evolution Ranking was not just a list of ranks; many evolutionary paths recorded on it were connected to the future situation on Canglan Star.

For example, if a citizen wished to try becoming an evolver, they would naturally prefer choosing an evolutionary path listed on the evolution ranking.

Evolvers of the same evolutionary path naturally gravitated towards each other and easily grouped together. Over time, forming a group was nothing unusual.

At that moment, as long as the creator of this evolutionary path stepped forward, they could easily rally a response, and establishing a force corresponding to that evolutionary path was merely a matter of speaking out.

The hundred evolutionary paths on the Canglan Evolution Ranking represented the most powerful hundred forces on Canglan Star.

These forces were deeply intertwined within Canglan Star, and their influence even spread to nearby star domains.

Half a year ago, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had risen remarkably, entering the top hundred of the ranking and causing a massive impact, dropping many jaws in surprise.

Just a few months later, not a few citizens on Canglan Star embarked on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Although no evolvers of corresponding realms, i.e., the Grandmaster Realm, had yet appeared, given enough time, it was only a matter of when.

Since the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had appeared on the evolution ranking, it must have been recognized by the three Goddesses, ensuring the correctness of its cultivation progress.

“Martial Path Evolutionary Path…”

Pei Lu’s expression became slightly serious.

He had reviewed this evolutionary path in the “Innate Chapter” and “Grandmaster Chapter.”

He had also recognized where the advantages of this evolutionary path lay.

That was its low threshold.

Compared to other evolutionary paths which required various external substances and medicines, or even special environments.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path almost had no requirements, simply needing citizens to cultivate day after day as instructed.

Perhaps stepping into the Grandmaster Realm is difficult and requires some talent, but for the Innate Realm… out of three or four thousand citizens, producing one was not very difficult.

“It’s a pity.”

“The limit is not high, only Third Rank…”

Pei Lu couldn’t help but shake his head.

His bloodline was also only Third Rank, but on Canglan Star, the world of bloodlines had always been uniform, only occasionally seeing existences with bloodlines reaching the Fourth Rank or even the Fifth Rank.

“However, recently, the Martial Path Evolutionary Path moved up from ninety-third to seventy-eighth place, which is quite interesting. Did the founder improve the related concepts?”

Pei Lu couldn’t help thinking to himself.

He was not too concerned about it.

The Canglan Evolution Ranking was divided into four layers.

The top ten was one layer.

From eleventh to thirtieth was one layer.

From thirty-first to fiftieth was one layer.

From fifty-first to one hundred was one layer.

From fifty-first to one hundred, the difference among these fifty evolutionary paths was not significant.

The limit was also generally Third Rank.

Centuries ago, no new evolutionary path had broken into the evolution ranking.

But changes from the top fifty to the top hundred in the ranking were not uncommon.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path, its potential is already set, belonging to the fourth layer of the evolution ranking. Perhaps soon, there will be evolvers of this path establishing a force that could shake Canglan Star?”

Pei Lu stroked his chin and speculated.

Just then.

The distant towering evolution ranking’s surface suddenly became blurry.

“It’s updating.”

Pei Lu’s thoughts twitched, and he watched intently.

At that moment, other figures in the plaza similarly looked over.

Very soon.

New text re-emerged.

Pei Lu, out of curiosity about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

Directed his gaze straight to the seventy-eighth place.

“Huh?”

“Why is the Martial Path Evolutionary Path gone?”

Pei Lu was shocked.

Subconsciously, he looked further down.

Seventy-ninth place.

Eightieth place.

Ninetieth place.

One hundredth place.

Pei Lu’s expression changed.

Could there be a problem with the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?

Was he kicked out by the Goddess of Wisdom?

Pei Lu found it hard to believe.

At the same time, he began from the seventy-eighth position and

looked upward.

Seventieth place.

Sixty-ninth place.

Sixtieth place.

Fiftieth place.

Until he had seen all the rankings of the last fifty positions on the Evolution Ranking.

Pei Lu still did not see the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“What on earth happened?”

Pei Lu’s eyebrows furrowed deeply.

At that moment,

Pei Lu suddenly noticed that the other people in the plaza had become somewhat noisy.

Especially a few individuals, who couldn’t control themselves and stood up from their positions, craning their necks to look up at the top of the Evolution Ranking.

“What’s happening?”

Pei Lu’s eyebrows slightly furrowed.

For several months, he had been watching the updated rankings on the Evolution Ranking right here.

The other people in the plaza had also been very quiet, so what was happening today?

Pei Lu didn’t understand.

Subconsciously, he looked towards the top of the Evolution Ranking, the top ten positions.

It was just a glance.

Pei Lu then saw that the eighth evolutionary path on the original Evolution Ranking had become—

the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“This…”

Pei Lu’s eyes widened, and it took him a long time to collect his thoughts.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path?

Number eight?

Wasn’t it seventy-eighth yesterday?

Pei Lu was completely taken aback and instinctively looked at the eleventh position.

The Titan Evolutionary Path.

This was originally the tenth on the Evolution Ranking.

Now it had been pushed down to the eleventh place.

“This… this is big news…”

Pei Lu swallowed hard and immediately began to contact the family head to send this information back.

Shuiyue Residential Complex.

Residence thirty-two.

A strange man stopped, standing in front of the door.

“Hello, Mr. Lin Yuan, this is the item you purchased; you can open it with your fingerprint.”

Lin Yuan took the sealed alloy handed over by the other party, running his finger over the top of the alloy box.

“BEEP! Fingerprint verified.”

A synthesized electronic voice sounded, and Lin Yuan took the alloy box directly.

The box was light, and if it weren’t for the faint sensation of huge energy fluctuations inside,

Lin Yuan might think there was nothing much inside.

“As expected of Cosmic Spiritual Objects.” A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

He could feel the energy fluctuations inside the box, belonging to Taiyang and Taiyin, even though they were not as strong as the Power of Taiyang and Taiyin inside the True Martial Sword in the Dragon Tiger World, they were not far off.

“Mr. Lin Yuan, if you confirm there’s no issue with the item, you could sign here.”

The delivery man next to him spoke up to remind him, looking at Lin Yuan with a hint of envy.

Even though he didn’t know what was inside the alloy box, he knew that the delivered item was of the highest class.

And usually, an item of this level was valued at least in the tens of millions, and anyone who could casually offer tens of millions in civilization currency was not ordinary.

After Lin Yuan’s signature, the delivery man then turned and left.

Lin Yuan, holding the box, returned to the underground training grounds.

Click.

The box opened.

It revealed two containers made from a special transparent metal inside.

The left container displayed a fiery red color, while the right one displayed a deep blue color.

“Truly beautiful…”

Lin Yuan looked at the two types of Cosmic Spiritual Objects.

After admiring it for a moment, he immediately began to train.

Two days later, the underground training ground.

Lin Yuan was seated cross-legged.

In front of him, both Solar Essence and Lunar Marrow were almost consumed.

“Second Layer Limit.”

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes, looked at the Solar Essence and Lunar Marrow, and a smile gradually appeared on his face.

With these two types of Cosmic Spiritual Objects, Lin Yuan had restored all of his strength in just two days.
